}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "(c) Raspberry Pi 2024 R5", "Made in the UK", Raspberry Pi logo, :"Raspberry Pi", and "Compute Module 5" are silkscreened on board top.
{{See also|RPF Raspberry Pi series}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Broadcom]] BCM2712 @2.4GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) *GPU: [[Broadcom]] VideoCore VII :OpenGL ES 3.1, Vulkan 1.2, :H.265 (HEVC) (up to 4Kp60 decode), :H.264 (up to 1080p60 decode, 1080p30 encode) *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash *Memory: 4 (LPDDR4X) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Cypress]] ([[Infineon]]) CYW43455 (1T1R) :SDIO 3.0: Wi-Fi 802.11ac, UART/PCM: BT 5.0 LE *Network: 1x GbE port via connectors *Power Source: 5V via connectors
